proposals.evidence: VM9 DECL builds new a3D('Sell - 240',...) whose onclick opens the sell overlay, and uses setText('Sell / '+price); SERVED DECL+USES show the identical sell-button structure with decoded keys.
proposals.name: sellButton

proposals.evidence: On both sides ac8 is {size:1,opacity:1} assigned into the sell button's text slot; all uses sit inside the DECL window but the text-style role matches on VM9 and SERVED.
proposals.name: sellTextOptions

proposals.evidence: Both sides construct ac9 via the sprite factory then drawImage(ac9.image) into per-rarity canvases tinted by rarity color and stored as rarityImg — the shared rarity base image.
proposals.name: rarityBaseSprite

proposals.evidence: On both sides acA is called after every trade-up list mutation (push/splice/clear/filter select) and its body toggles the trade-up vs equipped panels — the list refresh routine.
proposals.name: refreshTradeUpList

proposals.evidence: Both sides set acB true on mousedown/touchstart, false on mouseup/touchend/close paths, and guard the rotate handlers with if(!acB)return — the inspect-drag flag.
proposals.name: isInspectDragging

proposals.evidence: Both sides ease acC toward acD each frame (acC+=(acD-acC)*0.1) and apply it to the inspected model's scale — the current inspect zoom.
proposals.name: inspectZoom

proposals.evidence: On both sides the wheel handler clamps acD to 1.4..2.2 and acC lerps toward it — the target inspect zoom.
proposals.name: inspectZoomTarget

proposals.evidence: Both sides show acE created only as {scale:0} and immediately aliased by acF with zero independent uses, so it has no distinct role of its own to name.
On both sides acF is tweened on 'scale' (-0.8 to 0) at inspect open and read as acC+acF.scale when sizing the model — the animated zoom intro-offset state.
proposals.name: zoomIntroState

proposals.evidence: Both sides store changedTouches[0].identifier into acG on touchstart and match touch.identifier==acG in touchmove — the active inspect touch id.
proposals.name: activeTouchId

proposals.evidence: On both sides acH is a Vector2 seeded with the touchstart clientX/Y, then differenced against and updated from the moving touch — the last touch position.
proposals.name: lastTouchPos

proposals.evidence: Both sides build acI as WebGLRenderer over the inspect canvas (WebGL1Renderer fallback in catch) and call setSize/render/domElement/checkShaderErrors on it — the inspect renderer.
proposals.name: inspectRenderer

proposals.evidence: On both sides acJ is {canvas,antialias,alpha} passed to new WebGLRenderer; uses are confined to the DECL window but the renderer-options role is identical on VM9 and SERVED.
proposals.name: rendererOptions

proposals.evidence: On both sides acK is the same {canvas,antialias,alpha} shape passed to new WebGL1Renderer inside the catch fallback; DECL-window-only but role matches on both sides.
proposals.name: fallbackRendererOptions

proposals.evidence: Both sides define acL to setSize the renderer to window*devicePixelRatio plus domElement CSS size, called after canvas prepend, at init, and on resize — the inspect-renderer resizer.
proposals.name: resizeInspectRenderer
